About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About the Opportunity

WPP Media is seeking an experienced and driven Media Planner to join our team in Toronto, supporting the Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) account. JLR is one of the automotive industry's most recognized and prestigious brands, and this account demands an equally high caliber of media expertise.

This is a high-touch, high-performance account with a low tolerance for inefficiency. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with precision, speed, and strong accountability — functioning as the operational backbone of a lean, high-functioning planning team. This is not an entry-level role; it is designed for a planner who is ready to take full ownership and deliver excellence consistently.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Day-to-Day Planning Engine

• Lead the development and execution of integrated media plans across all channels with minimal oversight

• Translate strategic direction into detailed, actionable, and investment-ready plans quickly and accurately

• Ensure all media plans are performance-oriented and directly aligned to JLR's business objectives

• Maintain plan integrity across all revisions, stakeholder updates, and market changes

Operate with Speed and Precision

• Deliver high-quality planning outputs on tight timelines without compromising accuracy or attention to detail

• Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while upholding consistently high standards of output

• Anticipate team and client needs, moving work forward proactively rather than reactively

Drive Performance and Accountability

• Demonstrate strong command of lower-funnel strategies and lead generation tactics within the automotive category

• Continuously optimize media plans based on data-driven insights and performance signals

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale high-performing tactics, and eliminate underperforming investments

Communicate with Clarity and Structure

• Present recommendations in a clear, logical, and concise manner to both internal stakeholders and clients

• Transform ambiguity into structured, actionable next steps

• Produce work products that are polished, easy to understand, and require minimal revision

Enable and Support the Team

• Effectively manage up and down within the team structure: leverage the Planning Assistant for executional support while escalating critical decisions to the Planning Director as appropriate

• Keep the planning team aligned, organized, and consistently moving forward

• Serve as a force multiplier for the team — reducing friction and increasing overall efficiency

Demonstrate Professionalism and Ownership

• Take full end-to-end ownership of all work, including identifying, communicating, and resolving errors

• Surface risks early and arrive with proposed solutions, not solely with problems
• Maintain the highest standard of professionalism and composure within a demanding, fast-paced client environment

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 1-2+ years of media planning experience within an agency environment

• Demonstrated proficiency across paid media channels including Paid Search, Programmatic Display, Paid Social, Online Video, and Out-of-Home

• Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate performance data into clear, strategic recommendations

• Hands-on experience with industry-standard planning and buying platforms, including but not limited to DV360, The Trade Desk, SA360, Prisma, and/or MediaOcean

• Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a high-volume environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to clients or senior stakeholders

Preferred

• Experience working on automotive or similarly complex, performance-driven accounts

• Familiarity with lower-funnel and lead generation media strategies
• Experience managing or mentoring junior team members

What Success Looks Like in This Role

• Media plans are delivered on time, on brief, and with minimal rounds of revision

• The Planning Director is freed from day-to-day executional detail and able to focus on strategy and senior client leadership

• Performance data is actively monitored and used to drive continuous plan optimization

• The client experiences a seamless, confident, and highly responsive planning function

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:
As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be an Applied AI Engineer focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor to Enterprise Technology companies adopting the Claude API into their core products. You will work closely with customer product and engineering teams as they ship new products powered by Claude: advising on architecture design decisions, developing evaluation frameworks, and guiding customers through the most cutting-edge implementation patterns for LLMs.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide a focused portfolio of customers from technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll combine deep engineering expertise with customer-facing skills to help customers unlock the full potential of the Claude API and move their products closer to the frontier, while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Responsibilities:

• Partner with account executives and Applied AI Architects to translate customer business requirements into technical solutions

• Lead hands-on technical workshops and code reviews with customer engineering teams

• Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and building relationships
• Attend conferences, lead speaking engagements, and write blog posts and white papers on topics surrounding the AI space

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 4+ years of experience in technical roles such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Product Engineer, Software Engineer, or Technical Product Manager, with a desire to work closely with customers. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply.
• Production experience with LLMs, including advanced prompt engineering, agent development and frameworks, evaluation frameworks, transcript analysis, MCP, and deployment at scale
• Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python or TypeScript and experience building production applications
• Ability to navigate ambiguity and execute across domains with intellectual openness, finding simple solutions to complex problems
• High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity
• Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications
• Exceptional communication skills to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach

Please note this role requires 3 days in office per week.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$200,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

jobs.description: Overview Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity. With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. Business Segment Overview Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies Responsibilities Job Purpose At StoneX, Threat Management is more than monitoring alerts and responding to incidents— it’s about building the capabilities, teams, and intelligence that allow the business to operate confidently in an evolving threat landscape. As the Director of Threat Management , you’ll lead the strategy and execution behind our global Threat Management organization, including the Security Operations Center (SOC), Threat Detection & Applied Intelligence (TDAI), Exposure Management (Vulnerability M a nagement and Threa t Intelligence) , and Insider Risk. Your mission is to shape the future of how StoneX detects, responds to, and reduces cyber risk at scale. You’ll lead through transformation—modernizing operations, driving AI and automation adoption, strengthening detection and response capabilities, and developing resilient teams that can adapt to rapidly changing threats. This isn’t a role for managing alerts or operating tools directly— it’s a role for leading people, setting vision, and driving operational maturity through empowered teams and leaders . You’ll partner with technology, infrastructure, legal, HR, compliance, and business leadership to ensure Threat Management remains aligned to business priorities while enabling the organization to move quickly and securely. Primary duties will include: Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the long-term Threat Management strategy and roadmap aligned to enterprise risk priorities, evolving threats, and business objectives . Operational Excellence: Lead and mature global Threat Management operations, including SOC, incident response, detection engineering, exposure management, insider risk, and threat intelligence capabilities. Transformation & Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on AI, automation, detection engineering, threat hunting, and scalable security operations. Culture: Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning across global teams. Building Leaders: Develop managers and technical leaders into strong, empowered leaders capable of building high-performing global teams. Driving Outcomes: Establish measurable operational goals, maturity metrics, KRIs, and KCIs while ensuring accountability and continuous improvement across teams. Executive Partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and business leaders by translating cyber risk into meaningful business impact and operational readiness insights. Financial Stewardship: Support budget planning, vendor strategy, and investment prioritization to ensure Threat Management capabilities scale effectively and sustainably. As the Director of Threat Management, a typical week might include the following: Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with leaders, analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to drive alignment and operational momentum. Meeting with managers and technical leaders to review incidents, operational performance, staffing needs, roadmap progress, and strategic initiatives. Partnering with infrastructure, engineering, legal, HR, compliance, and business leadership to coordinate priorities and improve enterprise-wide security readiness. Reviewing major incidents, emerging threats, geopolitical risks, and operational trends while helping teams navigate high-pressure situations effectively. Coaching leaders in communication, decision-making, operational maturity, and team development strategies. Driving discussions around automation, AI capabilities, threat detection improvements, and long-term operational transformation initiatives. Participating in executive and cross-functional meetings to communicate risk, operational readiness, and Threat Management priorities. Reviewing vendor strategy, technology investments, staffing models, and budget priorities to ensure alignment with long-term operational goals. This job might be for you if: You’re culture-driven – you believe strong security teams are built through inclusion, mentorship, accountability, and continuous learning. You’re collaborative – you know the best security outcomes come from strong partnerships across business and technology teams. You’re calm under pressure – during incidents or crisis situations, people look to you for clarity, direction, and steady leadership. You’re approachable – whether working with analysts, engineers, executives, or business stakeholders, people trust your authenticity and communication style. You’re operationally minded – you thrive in fast-moving environments and can balance strategic thinking with strong operational execution. You’re a leader of leaders – you enjoy building managers and technical leaders into confident, capable leaders who empower their teams to succeed. You’re transformation-focused – you’re energized by modernizing security operations through AI, automation, and scalable processes. You’re strategically curious – you think beyond today’s threats and focus on how to evolve organizations for the future. Qualifications To land this role: Required qualifications: 1 2+ years of experience across cybersecurity and related enterprise technology domains. 7+ years of experience leading global security operations, Threat Management, or related security functions. Demonstrated leadership experience across one or more of the following areas: SOC operations, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, exposure management, insider risk, or security automation. Experience leading operational transformation initiatives focused on modernization, scalability, automation, or AI adoption. Strong understanding of cloud security, endpoint security, identity security, networking, and enterprise infrastructure environments. Experience managing high-pressure operational environments, crisis response, and enterprise-wide incident coordination. Proven ability to influence executives, communicate risk effectively, and lead cross-functional initiatives. Experience building strategic roadmaps, operational maturity programs, and measurable performance outcomes. Experience leading and developing geographically distributed teams. Preferred qualifications: Bachelor's or master's degree in information security , Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields. Equivalent experience and non-traditional paths are welcomed. Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, GCIA, GCIH, or related security certifications. Experience within highly regulated industries and/or financial services environments. Experience implementing AI-driven security operations or advanced automation capabilities within Threat Management programs. Experience representing organizations externally through industry engagement, conferences, or thought leadership initiatives .

jobs.description: The opportunity Make Unity run everywhere! That is the mantra of the Embedded OS Platforms team. 회사 소개

쿠팡파이낸셜은 기술과 고객 중심 사고를 바탕으로 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 만들어 가고 있습니다.

우리는 빠르게 변화하는 금융 환경 속에서 고객에게 최고의 경험을 제공하는 동시에 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 금융 서비스를 구축하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. Legal & Compliance 조직은 사업의 성장과 혁신을 지원하면서도 규제 준수와 리스크 관리를 책임지는 핵심 조직입니다.

쿠팡파이낸셜은 AML을 단순한 규제 준수 활동이 아닌 고객 보호와 지속 가능한 성장의 기반으로 생각합니다. 데이터와 기술을 활용하여 업계를 선도하는 AML 체계를 구축하고 함께 발전시켜 나갈 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

직무 소개

AML Team은 Coupang Financial Legal & Compliance 조직에 소속되어 자금세탁방지(AML) 및 테러자금조달방지(CFT) 업무를 담당하고 있습니다.

AML 보고책임자는 쿠팡파이낸셜 AML 프로그램 전반을 총괄하는 핵심 리더입니다. 고객확인(KYC), 거래모니터링(TMS), 의심거래보고(STR), 위험평가(RBA), 내부통제 등 AML 체계 전반에 대한 책임을 수행하며, 경영진 및 감독기관과의 주요 커뮤니케이션 역할을 담당합니다.

본 포지션은 단순한 관리자 역할이 아닙니다. 쿠팡파이낸셜은 소수정예 전문가 조직을 지향합니다. AML 보고책임자는 조직의 방향을 제시하는 리더인 동시에, 필요한 경우 직접 문제를 분석하고 해결하는 실무형 리더(Player-Coach)로 활동하게 됩니다. Policy 수립, 위험평가, 시스템 고도화, 주요 AML 이슈 검토, 신규 서비스 리스크 검토 등 핵심 과제에 직접 참여하며 Product, Engineering, Business 조직과 협업하여 혁신적인 금융 서비스와 효과적인 AML 통제 체계를 함께 만들어 나갑니다.

우리는 조직 규모를 키우는 것보다 높은 전문성과 실행력을 중요하게 생각합니다. 따라서 팀을 리딩하는 경험과 함께 스스로 문제를 정의하고 해결해 본 Hands-on 리더를 찾고 있습니다.

쿠팡파이낸셜의 AML 체계를 한 단계 더 발전시키고, 새로운 금융 서비스를 안전하게 성장시키는 과정에 직접 기여할 수 있는 분이라면 최고의 기회가 될 것입니다.

• AML 보고책임자로서 AML/CFT 체계 운영 및 고도화 총괄
• AML 정책, 절차 및 내부 규정 수립 및 관리
